title: A connection
description: An account the caller can connect, by its provider's name, whether they hold it, and whether a sign-in to it is under way. A value is never answered.

provider.description: The account's name: an OAuth app's, or an MCP server's that makes its own sign-in.

connected.description: Whether the caller holds it, which is what a call of an agent acting for them would use.

signing_in.description: In connections.list: whether a sign-in the caller started is under way. It turns false once the sign-in is granted, declined or expires.
